gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Nixie One draws every curve open and every stroke at a single width, like cut ribbon with a retro-tech hum. And Noto Sans Javanese, a plain sans, keeps its counters connected to the space outside, which is the quality that makes the pairing feel so unfussy.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-kawi:
Noto Sans Kawi has a c with open jaws, like pliers.

Nixie One bends its cable-like line into nostalgic display shapes, while the plain sans body simply gets on with being clean and neutral underneath.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-linear-a:
Nostalgic and a little retro-tech, the heading never swells or thins between stems and joins.

Noto Sans Linear A answers with a c that gapes visibly at any size, so the sans below feels clean and open while Nixie One hums above it.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Nixie One looks laser-cut from a single sheet, one stroke width running through its open, nostalgic curves and clear gaps. Noto Sans Linear B handles smooth bends in sans-serif form.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Nixie One holds a unit-width stroke from start to finish, nostalgic and retro-tech in its open curves. Noto Sans Mongolian then carries the text with flared terminals, so a long stretch of sans feels modern and neutral rather than tiring.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-lue: Noto Sans New Tai Lue shapes its round letters so they look cupped, not clenched, in a neutral, modern way. But Nixie One's ruler-straight line weight is what gives the pair its character, nostalgic and retro-tech above that softness.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-nko: Hardly any thick-thin swing shows up in Nixie One, just a nostalgic, retro-tech line with open curves. But Noto Sans NKo follows with c openings you can see through, giving the page a modern, contemporary sans-serif underlayer.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoined: Wire-smooth and wistful, Nixie One glides under the eye in open curves. Noto Sans NKo Unjoined follows with wide openings on small letters, an approachable sans-serif that keeps the page neutral beneath it.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-old-south-ara: Nixie One lays down a soft, featureless hum of constant-width strokes, nostalgic and retro-tech with its open curves and clear gaps. Its best quality is that smoothness against Noto Sans Old South Arabian.
gen-nixie-one-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Contemporary and clean, Noto Sans Shavian lets rope-loose curves finish without knotting at the ends. But the strongest quality is Nixie One, whose horizontals are no thinner than its verticals, giving that nostalgic retro-tech look.
